semiconductor_relevance: High — Applied Microengineering Ltd. specializes in wafer bonding equipment crucial for semiconductor device fabrication.
summary: Applied Microengineering Ltd. designs and manufactures advanced wafer aligner-bonders that provide exceptional flexibility for various bonding techniques. Their systems are utilized in both R&D and commercial production, accommodating wafer sizes up to 8 inches with high precision alignment capabilities.
capabilities: Wafer aligner-bonders for R&D and commercial production
Live, in-situ wafer-to-wafer alignment with 1µm accuracy
Multiple bonding techniques including thermocompression and adhesive bonding
Auto-align and bonding facilities via user-programmed recipes

regional_presence.United Kingdom: Applied Microengineering Ltd. is based near Oxford, UK, serving a worldwide customer base.
